app_description.message: Preview original webpages inline, with a remembered full-page Firefox window for strict sites.

command_open_sidebar.message: Open the active preview or page in the sidebar

command_open_tab.message: Open the active preview or page in a new tab

options_local_only.message: Settings stay in Firefox and are not sent to a remote server.

appearance_desc.message: Theme and motion settings apply to every GlassPeek page.

theme_desc.message: Follow the system, or use light or dark mode.

reduced_motion_desc.message: Shorten or remove window, menu, and notification animations.

backdrop_desc.message: Dim and blur the page behind an open preview.

triggers_desc.message: Several triggers can be on at the same time.

enabled_desc.message: Turn off page gestures, menus, and preview shortcuts.

long_press_desc.message: Hold a link until the progress completes to preview it.

long_press_delay_desc.message: Very short delays are easy to trigger by accident.

show_ring_desc.message: Show progress beside the pointer while holding.

drag_desc.message: Drag and release a link to create a preview.

drop_zone_desc.message: Only open when the link is dropped on the zone at the bottom of the page.

modifier_desc.message: Hold the chosen key and click a link.

hover_space_desc.message: Press Space over a link; forms and editors are excluded.

window_desc.message: Control window count, size, placement, and closing behavior.

multi_window_desc.message: Open several previews at once; clicking a window brings it to the front.

max_windows_desc.message: You get a notice when the limit is reached.

size_mode_desc.message: Use fixed pixels or percentages of the current viewport.

size_presets_desc.message: Presets update the current pixel dimensions.

position_desc.message: Place relative to the pointer or at the center of the viewport.

pin_default_desc.message: New previews stay open when you click the page.

remember_size_desc.message: Restore the last manually adjusted dimensions.

remember_position_desc.message: Restored windows are kept on screen.

fallbacks_desc.message: Normal sites open in the in-page preview. Sites that refuse embedding can use a full-page window instead.

original_mode_desc.message: Always load the exact URL you clicked, never a substitute.

history_desc.message: When on, pages you actually preview are added to Firefox history.

history_permission_on.message: Permission granted; preview visits are written to Firefox history.

history_permission_off.message: Off; Firefox history is not accessed.

history_permission_denied.message: History permission was not granted, so recording remains off.

new_preview_desc.message: With multiple windows on, links that target a new tab open in a new preview.

full_page_sites_desc.message: These sites skip inline preview and reuse one Firefox window. Other sites stay inline.

full_page_sites_empty.message: No sites remembered yet. You can add one from the preview window when a site cannot be shown in-page.

sites_desc.message: The most-specific domain wins, so a child domain can override its parent.

filter_mode_desc.message: Disable rules, allow by default, or only allow listed sites.

site_rules_desc.message: For example, block example.com but explicitly allow app.example.com.

shortcuts_desc.message: Shows the shortcuts Firefox actually registered.

shortcut_sidebar_desc.message: Sends the current preview's address if one is open, otherwise the current page.

shortcut_tab.message: Active preview or page → New tab

shortcut_tab_desc.message: Uses the current page when no preview is open.

advanced_desc.message: Copy environment details or restore the defaults.

diagnostics_desc.message: Version, platform, settings and shortcut status. No visited URLs.

reset_desc.message: Site rules and preview preferences also return to their defaults. The extension stays installed.

domain_invalid.message: Enter a valid domain such as example.com.

shortcut_missing.message: Some shortcuts are not assigned in Firefox.

shortcut_help_failed.message: Open about:addons, choose Manage Extension Shortcuts, and select GlassPeek.

copy_failed.message: Could not copy. Check Firefox clipboard permission.

reset_confirm.message: Restore every GlassPeek setting to its default value?

options_init_failed.message: Settings could not start. Reload this page.

popup_global_desc.message: Controls page triggers and preview actions everywhere.

popup_hint.message: Long-press, drag, or use your selected modifier key to preview links

popup_exact_override.message: This domain has an exact override

popup_default_allow.message: The current mode allows this site by default

popup_default_deny.message: The current mode blocks this site by default

popup_site_allowed.message: Allow rule created for this domain

popup_site_denied.message: Block rule created for this domain

sidebar_empty_desc.message: Use the shortcut to send the current page here, or choose the sidebar from a preview window.

sidebar_error_title.message: Cannot display this site in the sidebar

sidebar_error_desc.message: The site may block embedding. You can still use an original-page window or new tab.

sidebar_embed_notice.message: If content stays blank, the site may block embedding.

sidebar_timeout_title.message: The site did not become ready

sidebar_network_title.message: The site could not be loaded

sidebar_network_desc.message: Check the connection, then retry or open the page in a new tab.

sidebar_invalid_url.message: GlassPeek only opens valid public HTTP or HTTPS addresses.

sidebar_timeout_desc.message: The site did not respond. Try a full-page window or a new tab.

sidebar_blocked_desc.message: The site refuses to be embedded.

welcome_heading.message: Preview links without leaving the page

welcome_lead.message: Long-press a link to open it in a small window. Sites that refuse embedding can use a Firefox window instead.

welcome_feature_triggers_desc.message: Long press, drag, modifier click and hover + Space, each switchable on its own.

welcome_feature_windows_desc.message: Move, resize, pin and compare previews side by side.

welcome_feature_sidebar_desc.message: Each Firefox window has its own sidebar preview.

welcome_feature_fallback_desc.message: Open them once, or remember the site so it always opens in a Firefox window.

welcome_step_one.message: Move the pointer over a normal HTTP or HTTPS link.

welcome_step_two.message: Hold for about half a second and release after the blue ring completes.

welcome_step_three.message: Drag the top edge to move a preview. Everything else is in the menu.

welcome_safety_desc.message: Only the preview's own embedding restriction is relaxed. No browsing data is collected.

sidebar_external_notice.message: This action needs a full-page window; the sidebar will not silently download or open a tab.

preview_unsupported_link.message: This link type needs a full-page window.
